basic_info.description: Move-in ready home featuring a two-tiered fenced yard and covered patio - ideal for year round entertaining. Recently painted and upgraded, this home offers a comfortable nest for growing families. The eat-in kitchen features lots of storage, stone counters, gas/ stainless appliances, a skylight and views of the yard. Other attributes: hardwood floors, crown molding, a combined living room/ dining room experience complete with a wood-burning fireplace. Ideally located two blocks from Ocean Beach and walking distance to shops and restaurants on both Noriega and Taraval.
